description: Lakebase Search execution evidence: search_experiments tool retrieves from synced UC table in Lakebase Postgres (not a separate store)
search_query: SELECT experiment_id, experiment_name, variant, feature_area, observed_lift, description FROM app.experiments WHERE experiment_name ILIKE '%checkout%' OR description ILIKE '%checkout%' LIMIT 5

results.description: Experiment on the checkout flow, variant_a, tested on gen_z / android. WON: lifted conversion by 2.25 points.
Experiment on the checkout flow, variant_b, tested on millennial / web. Did not lift conversion.
Experiment on the checkout flow, variant_a, tested on gen_x / web. Did not lift conversion.
Experiment on the checkout flow, variant_a, tested on boomer / android. WON: lifted conversion by 2.34 points.
Experiment on the checkout flow, variant_b, tested on gen_z / android. WON: lifted conversion by 0.84 points.

segment_summary_search.query: SELECT segment_id, cohort, platform, segment_summary FROM app.segment_position WHERE segment_summary ILIKE '%checkout%' AND segment_id = 'SEG-0000214'

result.segment_summary: gen_z cohort on android in EMEA. Conversion sliding since the checkout change; a proven variant may recover it.

note: Both searches hit the same Lakebase Postgres tables that hold synced UC data. No separate vector store or external search service. The agent tool search_experiments calls ILIKE on the synced experiment catalog directly in Lakebase.
